column1: # The key map of SidPlayZero. This file is part of the specification (SPEC-094): the app's key handling,
# its action bar and its help are built from it, and the tests check against it.
# Columns, separated by tabs: where, key, action, label, priority, help.
#   where     a screen or panel (SPEC-090), or "always" (every screen and panel, also while typing) or
#             "moving" (every screen and panel while no text is being typed)
#   key       a key name from SPEC-111; "Char" is any character that can be typed
#   action    what the key does there; the same word means the same thing everywhere
#   label     the word shown above keys 4 to 8 in the action bar; "-" for other keys
#   priority  Must, Should or Could: a row that is not built is simply absent (SPEC-115)
#   help      the words shown for the key in the help panel
